title: THE FEAST — Every Game Engine, Past Present Future
philosophy: We find ALL the 'proprietary' engines and eat and remake IN the real engine. Emulation suits for the node atomic and petalTongue and esotericWebb. $0 lock-in. Only radiation economics.

engines_proprietary._note: These are FOOD. Every one gets eaten, patterns dissolved into Rust primals.

in_our_library: A Game About Digging A Hole

godot.redox: GDScript → Rust. Node → SceneNode (scene_tree.rs DONE). Shader → WGSL.

bevy.food_value: ECS architecture, wgpu rendering, hot reload, asset system. NATIVE RUST — no REDOX needed.

macroquad.food_value: Minimal 2D/3D, compiles to WASM instantly. Perfect for petalTongue lightweight games.

wgpu.food_value: THE rendering backend. Vulkan/DX12/Metal/WebGPU abstraction. petalTongue's actual renderer.
wgpu.status: CORE DEPENDENCY — already in the organism

rapier.food_value: Physics engine. Rigid body, collision, joints. Bevy's default physics.

graphics_apis_eaten._note: Every graphics API ever made is a layer we learn from and abstract away.

dx9.food: Fixed-function pipeline, shader model 2/3. The era of Half-Life 2.

dx11.food: Compute shaders, tessellation, multi-threaded rendering. The AAA standard for a decade.

dx12.food: Explicit GPU management. Command queues, descriptor heaps, root signatures. LOW LEVEL.

dx12_ultimate.food: Mesh shaders, raytracing (DXR), variable rate shading, sampler feedback.

directx.redox: All DX concepts map to wgpu/Vulkan abstractions. petalTongue speaks WebGPU which compiles to DX12 on Windows.
directx.lock_in: Windows-only. We eat the CONCEPTS, not the API.

vulkan.food_value: Cross-platform explicit GPU API. THE path to freedom from DX lock-in.
vulkan.status: wgpu's primary backend on Linux. Already in the organism.

opengl.food_value: The universal baseline. Every game engine started here. WebGL IS OpenGL ES.
opengl.status: tube.html's CRT shader runs on WebGL (OpenGL ES 2.0)

metal.food_value: Apple's GPU API. graftGate (M4) uses this. Unified memory, tile-based rendering.
metal.status: wgpu compiles to Metal on macOS. Covered.

webgpu.food_value: THE FUTURE. GPU compute in the browser. petalTongue's native target.
webgpu.status: THIS IS THE REAL ENGINE'S OUTPUT FORMAT. wgpu → WebGPU → every browser.

cuda.food: GPU compute paradigm. Abstracted by wgpu compute shaders.

dlss.food: AI upscaling. Tensor core magic. Eaten as pattern — petalTongue will do its own neural upscaling.

rtx.food: Hardware ray tracing API. DXR/Vulkan RT. wgpu ray tracing extension.

nvenc.food: Hardware video encoding. FFmpeg already wraps this.

physx.food: GPU physics. Abstracted by Rapier (Rust) or custom. Pattern eaten.

gameworks.food: HBAO+, HairWorks, Flow, Flex, WaveWorks. All visual effects we learn and reimplement in WGSL.

omniverse.food: Digital twin platform. Scene graph + physics + AI. The CONCEPT maps to esotericWebb.

fsr.food: FidelityFX Super Resolution — open source upscaling! Already AMD's gift to the world.

fidelityfx.food: Suite: denoiser, frame generation, upscaling. Open source. Direct food.

rdna.food: GPU architecture. Understood through Vulkan. deckGate has RDNA 2.

xdna.food: NPU architecture on Ryzen AI. The AMD equivalent of our Akida work.

rocm.food: Open compute platform. The open alternative to CUDA. coralReef targets this.

emulation_suit.concept: For each eaten engine, petalTongue can EMULATE its rendering style. Unreal's Nanite? Emulated in wgpu. Godot's 2D? Native in petalTongue. id Tech's BSP? Scene tree traversal. The Real Engine doesn't replace — it CONTAINS all engines.
emulation_suit.how: esotericWebb scene tree nodes carry a 'renderer_hint' property. petalTongue reads the hint and switches rendering mode per-node. One frame can mix Nanite-style virtualized geometry, retro pixel art, ray-traced reflections, and falling sand — all in the same scene tree.
